title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Control transaction isolation for queries and isolated storage (Query ReadState supports ReadCommitted)
summary: Query ReadState now supports ReadCommitted isolation levels in Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29), allowing AL queries to read only committed data and apply row locks for safer read-modify-write operations with configurable transaction isolation modes.
key_points: Queries can now use ReadState with four isolation levels: ReadUncommitted (default), ReadCommitted, ReadExclusive, and ReadShared
ReadCommitted reads only committed data without row consistency guarantees, improving performance over locked read modes
ReadExclusive and ReadShared place update or share locks on read data to prevent modification by other transactions
This feature brings query functionality in line with the ReadIsolation method introduced for Records in BC22

quotes.text: ReadCommitted: Reads only data that has been committed to the database. Rows read are not guaranteed to remain consistent throughout the current transaction.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the trade-off between consistency and performance with the new ReadCommitted isolation level

quotes.text: Setting the property to ReadUncommitted can improve performance compared to ReadShared and ReadExclusive.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the performance implications developers should consider when choosing isolation levels
